newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Banco di Napoli package may be cleared in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Banco di Napoli package may be cleared in Feb.

text.p: European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert said on Monday Italy's rescue package for Banco de Napoli went in the right direction and may be approved by the European Commission in February.
"Globally speaking, the dossier is on the right track," Van Miert told reporters.

He said that in principle he had no problems with the Italian treasury's decision to accept a joint bid by treasury-controlled Banca Nazionale del Lavoro and recently privatised insurer INA to take a joint 60 percent stake in the struggling Banco di Napoli although he would like more details about this.
He said the bid had been given credibility because private partners were involved.

"This move can be considered as one which is comparable to the attitude of a private investor. We need some additional information in the coming weeks to consolidate that presumption," Van Miert said.

Italy's centre-left government stepped in to save Banco di Napoli last year after the group announced record losses of 3.12 trillion lire for 1995. In a fight to stave off bankruptcy, the treasury launched a 2.0 trillion lira capital increase early last year and sought formal Commission clearance in July.
